source: Rules _ DCM - Code Quality Tool for Flutter Developers.html (dcm.dev/docs/rules/?presets=recommended, captured 2026-08-11)

rules.name: avoid-accessing-collections-by-constant-index
rules.description: Warns when a collection is accessed by a constant index inside a for loop

rules.name: avoid-always-null-parameters
rules.description: Warns when a private function or method has a parameter that always gets null

rules.name: avoid-assignments-as-conditions
rules.description: Warns when an assignment is used inside a condition

rules.name: avoid-cascade-after-if-null
rules.description: Warns when a cascade expression is used after if null (??) binary expression without parentheses

rules.name: avoid-casting-to-extension-type
rules.description: Warns when an expression is casted to an extension type

rules.name: avoid-collection-equality-checks
rules.description: Warns when a collection is checked for equality with another collection

rules.name: avoid-collection-methods-with-unrelated-types
rules.description: Warns when a collection method is used with an expression of an unrelated type

rules.name: avoid-commented-out-code
rules.description: Warns when a section of code is commented out

rules.name: avoid-conditions-with-boolean-literals
rules.description: Warns then a binary expression has a boolean constant that either makes the resulting value always the same or does not affect it

rules.name: avoid-constant-assert-conditions
rules.description: Warns when an assert statement has a constant condition

rules.name: avoid-constant-conditions
rules.description: Warns when both sides of a binary expression are constant

rules.name: avoid-constant-switches
rules.description: Warns when a switch expression or statement has a constant expression

rules.name: avoid-contradictory-expressions
rules.description: Warns when several conditions contradict each other
rules.notes: Detection scope and fix behaviour both unclear. Does it cover numeric range contradictions (a > 5 && a < 3) or only direct negation (a && !a)? And what does the quick-fix change, given a contradiction has no single safe rewrite?

rules.name: avoid-default-tostring
rules.description: Warns when a class is the target of the toString() invocation, but does not implement toString

rules.name: avoid-double-slash-imports
rules.description: Warns when an import/export directive contains a double slash

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-cascades
rules.description: Warns when a cascade expression has duplicate cascades

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-constant-values
rules.description: Warns when a class or enum declaration has several constants with the same primitive values

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-exports
rules.description: Warns when a file has multiple exports declarations with the same URI

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-initializers
rules.description: Warns when a final variable has the same initializer as another variable in scope

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-map-keys
rules.description: Warns when a map has duplicate keys

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-mixins
rules.description: Warns when a class has a mixin that is already present in that class's hierarchy.

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-patterns
rules.description: Warns when a LogicalOrPattern or LogicalAndPattern contains duplicate patterns

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-switch-case-conditions
rules.description: Warns when several switch cases have the same condition

rules.name: avoid-duplicate-test-assertions
rules.description: Warns when a test case has multiple test assertions with the same expression and expected value

rules.name: avoid-dynamic
rules.description: Warns when the dynamic type is used as a variable type in a declaration, a function return type, etc.

rules.name: avoid-empty-spread
rules.description: Warns when a collection literal in spread (...[]) has no elements

rules.name: avoid-empty-test-groups
rules.description: Warns when a test group does not have any test cases

rules.name: avoid-enum-values-by-index
rules.description: Warns when a enum value is accessed via Enum.values[index]

rules.name: avoid-equal-expressions
rules.description: Warns when both sides of a binary expression are the same

rules.name: avoid-excessive-expressions
rules.description: Warns when a condition has excessive expressions
rules.notes: "Excessive" is undefined and the rule is not configurable, so it is not an operand-count threshold. Candidate readings: boolean absorption (a && (a || b)), relational subsumption (x > 5 && x > 3), or repetition across if/else-if chains. Each needs a different implementation and a different fix.

rules.name: avoid-explicit-pattern-field-name
rules.description: Warns when an object pattern has an explicit field name

rules.name: avoid-future-tostring
rules.description: Warns when a Future is a target of the toString invocation or is used in an interpolation

rules.name: avoid-generics-shadowing
rules.description: Warns when a generic type shadows an existing top-level (class, mixin, typedef or enum) declaration

rules.name: avoid-implicitly-nullable-extension-types
rules.description: Warns when an extension type declaration does not have the implements clause

rules.name: avoid-inconsistent-digit-separators
rules.description: Warns when the digit separators create inconsistent groups of digits

rules.name: avoid-inferrable-type-arguments
rules.description: Warns when an inferrable type argument can be removed without affecting the code

rules.name: avoid-keywords-in-wildcard-pattern
rules.description: Warns when a wildcard pattern has declaration keywords

rules.name: avoid-late-final-reassignment
rules.description: Warns when a late final variable is assigned multiple times in the same block

rules.name: avoid-map-keys-contains
rules.description: Warns when Map's .keys.contains is used instead of containsKey

rules.name: avoid-missed-calls
rules.description: Warns when a method that should be invoked is passed as tear-off

rules.name: avoid-missing-completer-stack-trace
rules.description: Warns when Completer.completeError is called without providing a stack trace

rules.name: avoid-missing-enum-constant-in-map
rules.description: Warns when a enum constant is missing in a map declaration

rules.name: avoid-misused-set-literals
rules.description: Warns when a set literal is used in a wrong place

rules.name: avoid-misused-test-matchers
rules.description: Warns when an incorrect matcher or literal is used to verify the target expression

rules.name: avoid-multi-assignment
rules.description: Warns when multiple variable assignments are placed on the same line

rules.name: avoid-nested-futures
rules.description: Warns when a Future type contains another Future

rules.name: avoid-nested-records
rules.description: Warns when a record type declaration contains a nested record type declaration

rules.name: avoid-nested-shorthands
rules.description: Warns when a dot shorthand invocation has an argument that is also a dot shorthand

rules.name: avoid-never-passed-parameters
rules.description: Warns when a private function or method has an optional parameter that never gets a value

rules.name: avoid-not-encodable-in-to-json
rules.description: Warns when a toJson method references a non-encodable object

rules.name: avoid-nullable-interpolation
rules.description: Warns when an interpolation string contains a nullable value

rules.name: avoid-nullable-tostring
rules.description: Warns when the toString method is called on a nullable value

rules.name: avoid-only-rethrow
rules.description: Warns when a catch clause has only a rethrow expression

rules.name: avoid-passing-async-when-sync-expected
rules.description: Warns when an asynchronous function is used as an argument where a synchronous function is expected

rules.name: avoid-passing-self-as-argument
rules.description: Warns when an object is used as an argument to its own method

rules.name: avoid-recursive-tostring
rules.description: Warns when a toString method calls itself recursively

rules.name: avoid-redundant-async
rules.description: Checks for redundant async in a method or function body

rules.name: avoid-redundant-else
rules.description: Checks for else blocks that can be removed without changing semantics

rules.name: avoid-redundant-positional-field-name
rules.description: Warns when a record positional field has a name

rules.name: avoid-redundant-pragma-inline
rules.description: Warns when a @pragma('vm:prefer-inline') annotation has no effect

rules.name: avoid-referencing-discarded-variables
rules.description: Warns when a variable with the name that has only underscores (ex. _, __, etc.) is referenced

rules.name: avoid-renaming-representation-getters
rules.description: Warns when an extension type exposes a member that renames an existing representation field member

rules.name: avoid-self-assignment
rules.description: Warns when a variable or a class instance field / property is assigned to itself

rules.name: avoid-self-compare
rules.description: Warns when a comparison has both sides exactly the same

rules.name: avoid-shadowed-extension-methods
rules.description: Warns when an extension declares a method with the name that is already used by the extension target

rules.name: avoid-shadowing
rules.description: Warns when a declaration name shadows another declaration with the same name in the current scope

rules.name: avoid-stream-tostring
rules.description: Warns when a Stream is the target of the toString() invocation or is used in an interpolation

rules.name: avoid-suspicious-global-reference
rules.description: Warns when a subclass or an extension refers to a global identifier, but the parent class has an identifier with the same name

rules.name: avoid-suspicious-super-overrides
rules.description: Warns when a getter overrides a field that is already passed to the super constructor

rules.name: avoid-throw-in-catch-block
rules.description: Warns when a throw expression is called inside a catch block

rules.name: avoid-throw-objects-without-tostring
rules.description: Warns when a thrown object does not implement toString

rules.name: avoid-unassigned-fields
rules.description: Warns when a private field is not assigned a value

rules.name: avoid-unassigned-late-fields
rules.description: Warns when a private late field is not assigned a value

rules.name: avoid-unassigned-stream-subscriptions
rules.description: Warns when a stream subscription is not assigned to a variable

rules.name: avoid-uncaught-future-errors
rules.description: Warns when an error from a Future inside a try / catch block might not be caught

rules.name: avoid-unconditional-break
rules.description: Warns when a break, continue, return or throw are used unconditionally in a for loop

rules.name: avoid-unknown-pragma
rules.description: Warns when the @pragma annotation has an unknown value

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-call
rules.description: Warns when a .call() invocation is unnecessary and can be simplified

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-collections
rules.description: Warns when a collection literal can be replaced by its first and only element

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-compare-to
rules.description: Suggests replacing .compareTo() with an equality check (when applicable)

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-conditionals
rules.description: Checks for unnecessary conditional expressions

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-continue
rules.description: Warns when a continue statement is unnecessary and can be removed

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-enum-arguments
rules.description: Warns when a enum constant has an unnecessary empty argument list

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-extends
rules.description: Suggests removing unnecessary extends clauses that match default values for classes and type parameters

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-futures
rules.description: Warns when a return type of a declaration is unnecessary wrapped into a Future

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-if
rules.description: Warns when a return statement inside an if block is equal to the return statement after it

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-late-fields
rules.description: Warns when a late final field declaration is assigned in all constructors

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-length-check
rules.description: Warns when the if statement's condition has a collection length check that can be removed

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-local-late
rules.description: Warns when a late variable is assigned in all code branches before use

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-local-variable
rules.description: Warns when a local variable is not referenced or is only used as an initializer of another local variable

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-negations
rules.description: Warns when a negation can be simplified

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-null-aware-elements
rules.description: Warns when a null-aware element is unnecessary and can be removed

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-nullable-parameters
rules.description: Warns when a private function or method has a nullable parameter that never gets a nullable value

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-nullable-return-type
rules.description: Warns when the return type of a function or a method is declared nullable, but the function or method always return non-nullable value

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-overrides
rules.description: Warns when a parent declaration is overridden by a declaration without an implementation

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-patterns
rules.description: Warns when a pattern variable declaration does not affect the type of an existing local variable
rules.notes: Unclear which construct is targeted. "Pattern variable declaration" is the `var (a, b) = ...` statement form, but "does not affect the type of an existing local variable" reads like a non-narrowing type pattern in a case/if-case. The rule is also configurable and the option is not inferable.

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-reassignment
rules.description: Warns when a value is reassigned to a variable without using the initial value

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-return
rules.description: Warns when a return statement is unnecessary and can be removed

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-statements
rules.description: Warns when a statement is unnecessary and can be removed

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-super
rules.description: Warns when a constructor has an unnecessary super invocation or when an invocation has an unnecessary super prefix

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-type-assertions
rules.description: Warns about unnecessary usage of the is operator, and whereType and whereNotNull methods

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-type-casts
rules.description: Warns about unnecessary use of the as operator and cast method

rules.name: avoid-unreachable-for-loop
rules.description: Warns when the if statement's condition makes the inner for-loop unreachable

rules.name: avoid-unrelated-type-assertions
rules.description: Warns about unrelated usages of the is operator and whereType method

rules.name: avoid-unrelated-type-casts
rules.description: Warns about unrelated usages of the as operator and cast method

rules.name: avoid-unremovable-callbacks-in-listeners
rules.description: Warns when an addListener invocation receives a callback that cannot be unregistered

rules.name: avoid-unsafe-collection-methods
rules.description: Warns when first, last, single, firstWhere, lastWhere, singleWhere or [] methods are used on Iterable or its subclasses

rules.name: avoid-unused-assignment
rules.description: Warns when an assignment is not used in the subsequent statements

rules.name: avoid-unused-generics
rules.description: Warns when a function or method declares unused generic types

rules.name: avoid-unused-instances
rules.description: Warns when a newly created object is not being used

rules.name: avoid-unused-local-variable
rules.description: Warns when a local variable is not referenced and can be removed or renamed to _

rules.name: avoid-unused-parameters
rules.description: Checks for unused parameters inside a function or method body

rules.name: avoid-wildcard-cases-with-enums
rules.description: Warns when a switch on the Enum value has a wildcard pattern case

rules.name: avoid-wildcard-cases-with-sealed-classes
rules.description: Warns when a switch on a sealed class has a wildcard pattern case

rules.name: dispose-class-fields
rules.description: Warns when a field is not disposed in a class's dispose method

rules.name: function-always-returns-null
rules.description: Warns when a function with nullable return type returns only nullvalue

rules.name: function-always-returns-same-value
rules.description: Warns when a function always returns the same constant value

rules.name: match-base-class-default-value
rules.description: Warns when the default value of a parameter in an overridden method does not match the default value of the base class parameter

rules.name: match-getter-setter-field-names
rules.description: Warns when a getter or setter do not access at least one field with the name that matches the getter or setter name

rules.name: move-variable-closer-to-its-usage
rules.description: Warns when a variable is declared in the outer block, but used only in the inner one

rules.name: no-empty-block
rules.description: Disallows empty blocks except catch clause block

rules.name: no-equal-conditions
rules.description: Warns when a if statement has duplicate conditions

rules.name: no-equal-nested-conditions
rules.description: Warns when an if statement contains another if statement with the same condition

rules.name: no-equal-switch-case
rules.description: Warns when a switch has cases with equal bodies

rules.name: no-equal-switch-expression-cases
rules.description: Warns when a switch expression has cases with equal bodies

rules.name: no-equal-then-else
rules.description: Warns when if statement has equal then and else statements or conditional expression has equal then and else expressions

rules.name: prefer-any-or-every
rules.description: Warns when a collection's call chain can be rewritten to use .any() or .every() instead of .isEmpty or .isNotEmpty

rules.name: prefer-contains
rules.description: Suggests using .contains instead of .indexOf when checking for the presence of an element

rules.name: prefer-correct-callback-field-name
rules.description: Warns when a field with a Function type does not matched the configured name or a field with a non-Function type matches the configured name

rules.name: prefer-correct-for-loop-increment
rules.description: Warns when a for loop increments a wrong variable

rules.name: prefer-correct-json-casts
rules.description: Warns when a JSON object type cast is done in an unsafe way that will throw at runtime

rules.name: prefer-correct-test-file-name
rules.description: Warns if the file within /test contains a main, but the file name doesn't end with _test.dart

rules.name: prefer-declaring-const-constructor
rules.description: Warns when a class with no non-final fields has a non-constant constructor declaration

rules.name: prefer-explicit-function-type
rules.description: Warns when a Function type does not specify the return type and arguments

rules.name: prefer-iterable-of
rules.description: Warns when List.from() factory is used instead of List.of()

rules.name: prefer-match-file-name
rules.description: Warns when a file name does not match the class name

rules.name: prefer-null-aware-elements
rules.description: Suggests using null-aware elements (?element) instead of checking for a potential null value

rules.name: prefer-null-aware-spread
rules.description: Warns when a null check inside a collection literal can be replaced with a null-aware spread (...?)

rules.name: prefer-overriding-parent-equality
rules.description: Warns when a parent class implements hashCode and ==, but the child class does not implement them

rules.name: prefer-parentheses-with-if-null
rules.description: Warns when an if null (??) has a binary expression without parentheses

rules.name: prefer-prefixed-global-constants
rules.description: Warns when a global constant does not start with a configured prefix

rules.name: prefer-private-extension-type-field
rules.description: Warns when an extension type has a public representation field

rules.name: prefer-public-exception-classes
rules.description: Warns when an exception class declaration is not public

rules.name: prefer-return-await
rules.description: Warns when a Future is returned from a try / catch block without an await

rules.name: prefer-returning-shorthands
rules.description: Suggests returning dot shorthands from an expression function body

rules.name: prefer-shorthands-with-constructors
rules.description: Suggests using dot shorthand constructor invocations for the configured list of classes

rules.name: prefer-shorthands-with-enums
rules.description: Suggests using dot shorthands with enums

rules.name: prefer-shorthands-with-static-fields
rules.description: Suggests using dot shorthands with static fields

rules.name: prefer-simpler-boolean-expressions
rules.description: Suggests simplifying various boolean expressions

rules.name: prefer-simpler-patterns-null-check
rules.description: Warns when a patterns check for non-nullability can be simplified

rules.name: prefer-specific-cases-first
rules.description: Warns when a more specific switch case is placed after a more general one

rules.name: prefer-specifying-future-value-type
rules.description: Warns when a Future.value invocation gets a nullable argument, but the expected type is not nullable

rules.name: prefer-switch-with-enums
rules.description: Suggests to use a switch statement or expression instead of conditionals with multiple enum values

rules.name: prefer-unique-test-names
rules.description: Warns when the test name is not unique within the same test suite

rules.name: prefer-wildcard-pattern
rules.description: Warns when a dynamic or Object type is used instead of a wildcard pattern

rules.name: always-remove-listener
rules.description: Warns when an event listener is added but never removed

rules.name: avoid-empty-setstate
rules.description: Warns when a setState callback is empty

rules.name: avoid-flexible-outside-flex
rules.description: Warns when a Flexible widget is used outside the Flex widget

rules.name: avoid-incomplete-copy-with
rules.description: Checks if all parameters from the default constructor are added to the copyWith method

rules.name: avoid-incorrect-image-opacity
rules.description: Warns when an Image widget is wrapped into an Opacity widget

rules.name: avoid-missing-controller
rules.description: Warns when a TextFormField, TextField or EditableText does not have at least one way to get the updated value

rules.name: avoid-missing-image-alt
rules.description: Warns when an Image widget does not have a semanticLabel

rules.name: avoid-mounted-in-setstate
rules.description: Warns when a mounted check happens inside a setState callback

rules.name: avoid-recursive-widget-calls
rules.description: Warns when a Widget recursively uses itself

rules.name: avoid-state-constructors
rules.description: Warns when a State has a constructor with non-empty body

rules.name: avoid-undisposed-instances
rules.description: Warns when an instance that has a dispose method is not assigned to a variable

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-gesture-detector
rules.description: Warns when a GestureDetector widget has no event handlers

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-overrides-in-state
rules.description: Warns when a widget's State has unnecessary overrides

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-setstate
rules.description: Warns when setState is called inside initState, didUpdateWidget or build methods and when it is called from a sync method that is called inside those methods

rules.name: avoid-unnecessary-stateful-widgets
rules.description: Warns when a StatefulWidget can be converted to a StatelessWidget

rules.name: check-for-equals-in-render-object-setters
rules.description: Warns when a RenderObject setter doesn't have an equality check for the new value

rules.name: consistent-update-render-object
rules.description: Warns when an updateRenderObject method is absent or doesn't update all fields set in createRenderObject

rules.name: dispose-fields
rules.description: Warns when a widget state field is not disposed in dispose method

rules.name: pass-existing-future-to-future-builder
rules.description: Warns when a newly created future is passed to the FutureBuilder

rules.name: pass-existing-stream-to-stream-builder
rules.description: Warns when a newly created stream is passed to the StreamBuilder

rules.name: prefer-dedicated-media-query-methods
rules.description: Warns when MediaQuery.of or MediaQuery.maybeOf are used over dedicated methods (ex. sizeOf)

rules.name: prefer-single-widget-per-file
rules.description: Warns when a file contains more than one widget

rules.name: prefer-spacing
rules.description: Suggests using the spacing argument of a Row, Column or Flex instead of using SizedBox widgets for adding gaps between children widgets

rules.name: proper-super-calls
rules.description: Checks that super calls in the initState and dispose methods are called in the correct order

rules.name: use-closest-build-context
rules.description: Warns when the referenced BuildContext variable is not the closest BuildContext

rules.name: use-setstate-synchronously
rules.description: Warns when setState is called past an await point
